game: Xenoblade Chronicles 3D (New Nintendo 3DS), product KTR-P-CAFE v1.0 (USA), title ID 000400000F700100
source_of_truth: phase3a/src/xc3d.py (SCHEMA covers every byte; checked at import). Evidence: XC_THREE_WAY_PHASE3A.md section 3.

save_archive.other: specialmode (Special Mode / extras, not a playthrough slot; not converted)

container.0x08: u32le size of the QuickLZ block
container.0x0C: one QuickLZ 1.5 level-3 block: flags 0x4F, u32le block size, u32le decompressed size, control words + data
container.note: phase3a/src/qlz.py recompresses every game-written file byte-identically

payload.relation_to_wii: the Wii SX4E layout at identical offsets, little-endian scalars, C bitfields LSB-first (armcc) instead of MSB-first (CodeWarrior), same declaration order

section_header.+0xC: u32 CRC-16/XMODEM (poly 0x1021, init 0) of [crc_start, crc_end) (Wii: u16 0 + CRC-16/ARC)

payload.fill: struct padding and inter-section space = 0xE3 (heap fill); the Wii writes 0

fields.+0x0A: u16 play hours, u16 play minutes, u16 map area

sections.type: u32 words (32/16/8/1-bit banks, LSB-relative shifts as on the Wii)

regions.0xB260: 2 x {u16 map sub, u16 map area, char[0x20] name}
regions.0xB2A8: u32 x3 (inferred), u16 x2 (value 1,1 in every sample)
regions.0xD25C: minimap bit array (byte + LSB bit), Collectopaedia bits from 0xEAC6, to 0xEAEE; 2 pad

character_record.+0x000: u16 id, u16 equip gid[6], u16 equip row[6], 2 pad
character_record.+0x028: armour cache[5] = u16[16] ([9] dodge, [11] phys def, [12] ether def, [13] armour type)
character_record.+0x0C8: weapon cache: f32 range near*0.01, f32 range far*0.01, f32 speed*0.1, u16 dmg low, dmg high, att_lev, 0, block, phys def, ether def, 0, u8 weapon type, u8 element, u16 flag
character_record.+0x0E8: u8 art levels [24][2], palette flag, palettes, talent arts, u8[0x48]
character_record.+0x180: f32 x6 (current HP, .., max HP at +0x18C)
character_record.+0x284: u32 affinity coins, SP[5], selected tree, EXP accum, EXP, AP
character_record.3ds_note: the 3DS loads +0x17C..+0x1F4 and the caches as live values (no recompute on load): xc3dstats rebuilds them exactly as the game's level-up routine (0x2AB6B0) and Monado scaling (0x277300)
